title: WASM Crate Integration (fjadra profile)
content: Template for adding WASM to Angular: crate must be cdylib + wasm-bindgen + serde, fs-free, tokio-free, rayon-optional, pure computation. Build with wasm-pack build --target web. Lazy-load via dynamic import() in Angular service. Never wrap the full engine — only pure-compute, chatty operations. Each WASM addition should delete its HTTP predecessor. Full reference: @wiki/patterns/wasm-crate-integration
